note: Rock County NE zones through a Zoning Resolution (amended 2001) whose Official Zoning Map is a signed paper/PDF copy kept at the county office. The county's public GIS viewer (rock.gworks.com) shows parcel and aerial layers with no zoning layer or ArcGIS REST service found. ArcGIS search found no county or Bassett zoning service; the only zoning attributes found are in commercial parcel aggregators (landrecords.us), not official. No queryable zoning district polygons were published.
